title: Nebula EAV Form Definition
description: Declarative schema for a Nebula EAV admin form (type=eav). Files live at view/adminhtml/form/<id>.json and MUST set `type: "eav"` and `entity`. Inherits all shared form primitives (dataSource, settings, layout, fieldsets, field) by reference from form.schema.json.

id.title: Form identifier
id.description: Unique snake_case identifier. Base files MUST set this. Overlay files MUST omit it.

type.title: Definition type marker
type.description: Must be the literal string `eav` to select the EAV form runtime.

entity.title: EAV entity code
entity.description: Magento EAV entity code: the attribute set to pull attributes from. E.g. catalog_product, catalog_category, customer.

attributeSet.title: Attribute set override
attributeSet.description: Optional attribute set code or id to override the entity default.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: Form data provider. Same shape as non-EAV forms.

fieldsets.title: Fieldsets
fieldsets.description: Rare in EAV forms; prefer `layout`. Use to add non-EAV fieldsets that live alongside the attribute tree.

layout.title: Layout tree
layout.description: Tree of layout nodes. EAV forms typically pick attribute groups into sections via `groups` and individual fields by name.

excludeGroups.title: Exclude attribute groups
excludeGroups.description: Attribute group codes to strip from the EAV tree before merging with the declared layout.

overrides.title: Attribute overrides
overrides.description: Per-field overlays applied to attributes resolved from EAV.

fields.title: Field overrides map
fields.description: Map of attribute_code -> partial field definition (merged into the EAV-resolved attribute).

oneOf.title: Base EAV form
oneOf.description: A standalone EAV form. Must set id, type, entity.

oneOf.title: EAV overlay fragment
oneOf.description: An overlay from another module. Must NOT set id/type/entity.
